mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -15.7 to -7.4 over the four weeks ending 2021-12-15, a recovery momentum that persists into the next four weeks and lifts the 28-day mean above the prior 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved each week from -15.7 to -7.4
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days despite four consecutive weekly improvements.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -25.0 and staying there signals relaxation of capacity restrictions; this policy easing raises retail-and-recreation footfall over the following two weeks, pushing RETAIL_REC higher.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT > -25.0 for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean despite TRANSIT remaining above -25.0 for two consecutive weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous positive GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS alongside falling RESIDENTIAL shows households shifting from staying home to local errands and outdoor leisure; this substitution increases RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose 0.6 to 5.9, PARKS turned positive at 2.6, RESIDENTIAL fell 16.7 to 14.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean does not exceed last 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM > 0, PARKS > 0, and RESIDENTIAL < 15.0 hold simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: The year-end holiday shopping period in Singapore produces a seasonal lift in retail-and-recreation visits; with RETAIL_REC already trending upward, this seasonal effect raises the next four-week mean above the prior four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2021-12-15 falls in year-end holiday season
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean during the year-end holiday season.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improvements are complementary commuting signals; when both exceed reopening thresholds, more workers travel to offices and patronize nearby retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean while TRANSIT > -25.0 and WORKPLACES > -17.0.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remains 14.0 points above baseline, showing work-from-home still suppresses daytime retail trips; a drop below 14.0 will release pent-up shopping demand and raise RETAIL_REC within one week.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below 14.0 but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the following week.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT still 22.3% below baseline and WORKPLACES 15.0% below baseline indicate binding capacity limits and remote-work directives; these constraints cap retail recovery and push RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds last 28-day mean while TRANSIT < -20.0 and WORKPLACES < -15.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GROCERY_PHARM from 0.6 to 5.9 reflects holiday meal and pharmacy stockpiling; this diverts spending from malls and recreation venues, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose 0.6 to 5.9 while RETAIL_REC remained negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM continues to rise.
